No, the employer likely cannot enforce the covenant, so D is the best answer. Because the employee was at-will, the employer's "continued employment" was not a real promise it had to keep, so it is illusory and gives her nothing new for signing. The shared note misstates the rule: a post-hire change needs consideration unless it fits narrow exceptions (such as Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 89 for unforeseen circumstances), and a few jurisdictions accept continued at-will employment as consideration, so the answer depends on the governing law.

CONFIDENCE: 70
